howto.what: Claude 会遵循智能告警模式：按根因分组告警、设定严重等级与冷却期、抑制症状告警；监控 token 用量、响应质量、循环及静默失败，并自动路由、升级或触发修复。
howto.when: 当你要求配置告警规则、监控 AI 代理运行状态，或处理告警路由、升级、自动化修复时触发。

say.text: 帮我设置告警分组，按服务分组。
say.note: Claude 会创建 group_by 规则。

say.text: 对P0级别的告警立即通知我。
say.note: Claude 会配置 P0 即时通知。

say.text: 当API高频延迟时只发一个告警。

howto.what_en: Claude follows smart alerting patterns: group alerts by root cause, set severity levels & cooldowns, suppress symptoms; monitor token usage, response quality, loops & silent failures, and auto-route, escalate or trigger remediation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to configure alert rules, monitor AI agent status, or handle routing, escalation, or automated remediation.

say_en.text: Set up alert grouping by service.
Notify me immediately for P0 alerts.
